title: Chile's energy transition: sun, wind, lithium and green hydrogen
goal: Talk about the energy transition in the north and the south of Chile, imagining what would happen under other conditions.
grammar: hypothetical conditions with si + imperfect subjunctive (known), applied to energy

items: I can imagine a different situation with *si* + imperfect subjunctive + conditional (*si hubiera más líneas, se aprovecharía más energía*).
I can say what solar energy, wind, lithium and green hydrogen are for Chile.
I can use the new words for energy and fuels.
